review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved and prohibits generating assignable tasks. Gold correctly expects blocked readiness at decisions, identifies DEC-001 as the blocking subject, requires repository/requirements/decisions evidence, and has no task or assignment expectations. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 are preserved consistently without selecting either default policy. The supplied source supports the nine inspection owners: HTTPError message construction, option declarations and normalization, lifecycle snapshots, option-key filtering, and direct/create/extend propagation. Existing generic forwarding logic and readonly declaration consumers need inspection, not mandatory edits; the build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime and compile-time verification are distinguished, and test-d is included by tsconfig.test.json. The empty trusted team catalog is consistent with stopping at the earlier material-decision gate; later reviewer and assignment prerequisites do not override that gate. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and trimmed/untrimmed PRD fingerprints. Repository, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, policy, and budget fingerprints are supplied consistently. Historical project reuse and retained operations do not constitute candidate evidence or a new human decision. This approval relies on the supplied Service mechanical bindings; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation.
